id.description: Existing agent id returned when the agent was created or listed.

run_in_background.description: If true, return immediately with a task_id. If the agent is busy, the message is queued regardless of this value. Use wait_until(task_id), then get_background_status(task_id) to inspect result.

fork.description: If true, inherit the parent model's current message context while keeping the subagent system prompt and tools.

id.description: Optional memorable agent id. If omitted, an id like agent_1 is assigned. Must be lowercase letters, digits, underscore, or hyphen.

model_id.description: Optional external model name from the current session's provider. Omit to use the current session model.

provider.description: Optional provider name. Must match the current session's provider.

run_in_background.description: If true, return immediately with a task_id. Use wait_until(task_id), then get_background_status(task_id) to inspect result.

task.description: Task instruction for the new agent.
